Finite geometric-weight majorization with equal-tail replacement proves convex order for all model parameters; independent Gaussian-square scaling preserves it. Symbolic derivatives and 205 deterministic checker assertions independently spot-check calculations; infinite statements rely on the presented argument.

The final joint contribution is the fully quantified variance-matched family order, sharp simultaneous Laplace/Gaussian stop-loss risk bounds and explicit first-order Gaussianization coefficient for positive thresholds.
